title: AutoCharge Facility (ACF) for BPI Credit Cards Authorization Form

fields.label: Accomplish this form and prepare a copy of your valid government-issued ID and your utility bill statement of account.
fields.reference: Complete the form and attach a valid ID and utility bill.

fields.label: To submit for enrollment, visit your nearest BPI branch or call our 24-hour BPI Contact Center at (632) 889-10000 for email instructions.
fields.reference: Submit at a BPI branch or contact BPI for email instructions.

fields.label: Kindly ensure that the BPI Credit Card you are nominating is active.
fields.reference: Make sure the nominated BPI Credit Card is active.

fields.label: Principal Cardholder’s Name
fields.reference: Enter the name of the principal cardholder.

fields.label: Supplementary Cardholder’s Name
fields.reference: Enter the name of the supplementary cardholder (if applicable).

fields.label: Mobile Phone Number
fields.reference: Enter the mobile phone number.

fields.label: I want to:
fields.reference: Select the purpose of the form.

fields.label: Enroll my BPI Credit Card to the BPI AutoCharge Facility
fields.reference: Check to enroll the BPI Credit Card.

fields.label: Card Number
fields.reference: Enter the card number.

fields.label: Card Expiry (MM/YY)
fields.reference: Enter the card expiry date in MM/YY format.

fields.label: Change/Update my nominated credit card and/or card expiry
fields.reference: Check to change/update card details.

fields.label: From:
fields.reference: Enter the old card expiry date.

fields.label: To:
fields.reference: Enter the new card expiry date.

fields.label: Cancel my BPI AutoCharge Facility enrollment
fields.reference: Check to cancel enrollment.

fields.label: Card Number
fields.reference: Enter the card number for cancellation.

fields.label: Card Expiry (MM/YY)
fields.reference: Enter the card expiry date in MM/YY format.

fields.label: Account Name
fields.reference: Enter the account name for Meralco.

fields.label: Customer Account Number
fields.reference: Enter the 10-digit customer account number from the Meralco billing statement.

fields.label: Account Name
fields.reference: Enter the account name for Meralco.

fields.label: Customer Account Number
fields.reference: Enter the 10-digit customer account number from the Meralco billing statement.

fields.label: Principal Cardholder’s Name and Signature
fields.reference: Sign and print the name of the principal cardholder.

fields.label: Date
fields.reference: Enter the date of signing.

fields.label: Supplementary Cardholder’s Name and Signature (if applicable)
fields.reference: Sign and print the name of the supplementary cardholder (if applicable).

fields.label: Date
fields.reference: Enter the date of signing.

fields.label: Request filed through Contact Center
fields.reference: For office use only; leave blank.

fields.label: Request filed through Branch
fields.reference: For office use only; leave blank.

fields.label: Service Request No.
fields.reference: For office use only; leave blank.

fields.label: DTAS Request No.
fields.reference: For office use only; leave blank.
